mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 4% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rises above 4% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When employment increases (PAYEMS) but unemployment decreases (UNRATE), it indicates a tight labor market, which may lead to inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Employment increases and unemployment decreases, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate exceeds 5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflation, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns if not offset by growth, over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPI increases but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced supply, potentially leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Industrial production declines but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) coupled with weak retail sales (RSAFS) indicates imbalanced demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDP grows while retail sales are weak, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weaker demand in the housing sector, potentially leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Housing starts decline but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
